chars.SON: SON: a skinny 17-year-old Moroccan boy wearing a white baker's apron dusted with flour over a mustard-yellow hoodie, dark jeans, red sneakers
chars.DAD: DAD: a stocky Moroccan father in his fifties with a short grey moustache, wearing a dark blue mechanic overall with grease stains, sleeves rolled up
chars.RACHID: RACHID: a chubby cheerful Moroccan pastry shop owner in his sixties, wearing a tall white chef hat and a white chef jacket with a brown checkered scarf

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a modest Moroccan living room in Meknes with a low sedari sofa and a tea tray, DAD stands holding up a new school backpack toward SON with a stern raised eyebrow, while SON stands facing him holding a tray of Moroccan cookies, looking nervous and guilty. Open tension between them, comic mood.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Inside a small Moroccan neighborhood pastry kitchen, RACHID wags a finger at SON giving serious advice, SON listens while kneading dough on a floury wooden table, trays of pastries behind them.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Inside a Moroccan pastry shop, SON proudly shows RACHID a big tray of perfect kaab el ghazal and chocolate pastries, RACHID looks amazed with wide eyes and hands raised in surprise.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Evening in a modest Moroccan living room, DAD sits relaxed on the sedari sofa sipping mint tea, SON sits at the other end of the sofa staring at the floor, worried, a wall calendar on the wall behind them (blank, no writing).

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: In the Moroccan living room, DAD points firmly at a new school backpack and notebooks placed on the low table, speaking to SON, SON forces a fake smile and nods.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Close medium shot of SON sitting on the sofa sweating heavily, biting his lip, eyes darting sideways, hesitating, cozy Moroccan living room background with patterned cushions.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: In the Moroccan living room, SON stands up in front of seated DAD and speaks nervously with one hand raised, DAD freezes with the tea glass halfway to his mouth, shocked.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: In the Moroccan living room, SON waves his floury hands explaining excitedly and holds a bag of flour, DAD sits completely still with an unreadable stern face, arms crossed.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Dramatic moment in the Moroccan living room: DAD slowly stands up and stares down intensely at SON, SON shrinks back frozen and stammering, a single tea glass on the table, suspenseful lighting.
